title: Fit Tool Results into a Token Budget
hints: Charge every error result in full first. Split what is left evenly over the other results with integer division.
Truncate by token, not by character: cut the text at the end of the k-th match of the tokenizer regex, and reserve the 5 tokens the marker costs.
A list keeps a prefix of whole items. Stop at the first item that does not fit, and reserve 3 tokens for the cursor.
